name: Custom Cursor
description: Dot + lagging ring cursor with states: grows over links, becomes a 'View'/'Drag' bubble over tagged media.
a11y: Native cursor restored on touch devices and reduced motion; states are decorative (links stay real links).
perf: Springs on two absolutely positioned elements; one pointermove listener.
props: Attribute on children to switch state.
prompt: Build a scoped custom cursor: hide the native cursor inside the area; a 6px dot follows the pointer exactly and a 30px ring follows on a spring (260/26/.6) with mix-blend difference. Read `data-cursor`/`data-cursor-text` from the hovered element (closest) to grow the ring to 48px (links) or a 72px white bubble with a label.

name: Image Trail
description: Moving across the area drops a trail of images that pop in, drift in your direction and fade away.
a11y: Images are decorative (empty alt) and pointer-events none; off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: Spawns one per threshold distance; WAAPI animation, removed on finish.
prompt: Create an image trail: on pointermove, once the pointer has moved `threshold` px since the last spawn, append an absolutely positioned 140px image at the pointer and animate it with WAAPI: scale .4→1 pop, then drift by 60%→100% of the movement vector while shrinking and fading over 1.1s; remove on finish.

name: Click Spark
description: Clicking anywhere in the area emits a tiny starburst of sparks from the click point.
a11y: Canvas overlay is aria-hidden with pointer-events none; skipped under reduced motion.
perf: rAF runs only while sparks are alive (450ms).
prompt: Make click sparks: on pointerdown push N sparks at evenly spaced angles; a rAF loop draws each as a short line moving outward (distance eased cubic-out to 34px, length shrinking from 12px) for 450ms on an overlay canvas, then stops.

name: Liquid Cursor Blob
description: Three blobs chase the cursor at different lags and fuse into one liquid shape through an SVG goo filter.
a11y: Decorative layer behind content; disabled on touch and reduced motion.
perf: Three springs; filter on one layer.
prompt: Create a gooey cursor: three circles (sizes 72/54/36px) follow pointer x/y through springs of decreasing stiffness (400, 160, 80) inside a layer filtered by feGaussianBlur(12) + alpha feColorMatrix (30, −12), so they merge into a stretching liquid shape.

name: Following Eyes
description: A pair of googly eyes whose pupils track the cursor anywhere on the page, blinking every few seconds.
a11y: Fully decorative (aria-hidden); off on touch and reduced motion.
perf: One window pointermove listener; translate on two pupils.
prompt: Build following eyes: two white circles with dark pupils; on window pointermove compute the angle from each eye's center to the pointer and translate its pupil by min(size·.22, distance/10) in that direction; blink by animating an eyelid scaleY every 3.8s.

name: Crosshair Cursor
description: Full-bleed crosshair lines track the pointer with a live x/y readout — design tools and technical brands.
a11y: Overlay is aria-hidden; off on touch/reduced motion.
prompt: Create a crosshair overlay: on pointermove render a horizontal and vertical 1px line through the pointer across the whole area plus a small label with integer coordinates offset 8px; hide on leave.

name: AI Prompt Box
description: Chat composer: auto-growing textarea, animated attachment chips, model picker and a send button that morphs into Stop while generating.
a11y: Labelled textarea, Enter to send / Shift+Enter newline, labelled icon buttons, native select for the model.
perf: Layout animation only when chips change.
prompt: Build an AI composer card: textarea that auto-grows to 200px, attachment chips that pop in/out (AnimatePresence + layout), a model select, and a circular send button that swaps (rotate+scale) to a filled-square Stop icon while a promise is pending. Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Focus-within ring.

name: Thinking Steps
description: Reasoning disclosure: the current step shimmers, finished steps tick off, then it collapses into 'Thought for Ns'.
a11y: Disclosure button with aria-expanded; steps list is aria-live polite.
perf: Text shimmer is CSS; one timer.
prompt: Create a 'thinking' disclosure: header shows the current step with a CSS shimmer (background-clip text) and a chevron; the open list shows completed steps with green checks and the current one with a spinner; when done, the header becomes 'Thought for Ns' and auto-collapses.

name: Streaming Chat
description: Chat thread where messages spring in and assistant replies stream word-by-word after a typing indicator.
a11y: role=log with aria-live polite; reduced motion shows replies whole.
perf: Only the streaming bubble re-renders per token.
props: Messages to play (swap for your stream).
prompt: Build a chat thread: user bubbles right (dark), assistant left (muted). Messages enter with y 12→0, scale .97→1 springs. Before each assistant reply show three bouncing typing dots, then stream the reply word-by-word (45ms) with a blinking block caret, then commit it as a normal bubble. Auto-scroll to the end.

name: Voice Orb
description: Siri-like voice orb: additive blurred color fields that breathe when idle, swell with input level and swirl while thinking.
a11y: role=img with the current state in its label; static frame under reduced motion.
perf: Three radial gradients per frame on a small canvas; pauses off-screen.
prompt: Create a voice orb on canvas with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter': for each color draw a radial gradient circle orbiting the center (angle = t·spin + offset); radius and orbit wobble with an amplitude that depends on state (listening: .15 + level·.35, speaking: pulsing, thinking: faster spin). Light CSS blur.

name: Voice Input Wave
description: Mic button that expands into live waveform bars and a timer — plug in an AnalyserNode for real levels.
a11y: aria-pressed mic button with clear labels; timer has role=timer; bars aria-hidden.
prompt: Build a voice input pill: a round mic button (turns red, icon swaps to mic-off when recording) and, while recording, a row of 3px bars whose heights spring to levels (simulated or from an AnalyserNode) plus an m:ss timer; pill grows with Motion layout.

name: Prompt Suggestions
description: Suggested-prompt chips cascade in with blur and lift on hover; picking one hands its text to your composer.
prompt: Create suggestion chips: a wrapping list whose items enter with opacity 0, y 10, blur 4px → rest via staggerChildren .06; each chip lifts −2px on hover, scales .97 on tap and calls onPick(label).

name: Code Stream
description: A code window that streams in token by token like an AI writing it, with syntax colors, a block caret and a 'writing' status.
a11y: The full code is exposed via aria-label on <pre>; reduced motion shows it instantly.
prompt: Build a streaming code window: dark card with traffic-light dots and file name; an interval increments a character count and renders pre-tokenized [text, kind] spans truncated to that count with kind→color classes, plus a pulsing block caret and '● writing' until complete.

name: Agent Run Timeline
description: Agent tool calls appear one by one with a pulsing running state, then resolve to a check with their result.
a11y: Ordered list with aria-live polite; status conveyed by text, not only color.
perf: Layout animation as steps are appended.
prompt: Create an agent timeline: a vertical rail; steps append with y 10→0 springs; the running step shows its tool icon in a violet ring with a ping and an ellipsis, finished steps turn into green checks and reveal a detail line (height auto).
